title: A map of the microwave sky
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The microwave background has nearly the same temperature in all directions, with very small variations. Those variations contain information about the early universe.

misconception: A learner may choose: Perfectly identical in every measured direction
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: How uniform is the cosmic microwave background temperature across the sky?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: How uniform is the cosmic microwave background temperature across the sky? Nearly uniform, with tiny variations. The microwave background has nearly the same temperature in all directions, with very small variations. Those variations contain information about the early universe.
Visual caption: Almost smooth, tiny patterns. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: How uniform is the cosmic microwave background temperature across the sky?
options: Perfectly identical in every measured direction
Randomly different by thousands of degrees
recall.why: The microwave background has nearly the same temperature in all directions, with very small variations. Those variations contain information about the early universe.
